description: Port the full set of ExtensionAPI action methods beyond the basics in .3. Upstream types.ts 1156-1290, loader.ts 193-339. Includes: session state (sendMessage, sendUserMessage, appendEntry), session metadata (setSessionName, getSessionName, setLabel), tool management (exec, getAllTools), commands (getCommands). These are bound during the bindCore phase (runner.ts 261-331) and require the two-phase stub/real binding pattern. The port map's API struct (section 5.3) covers some of these but several are missing.
title: Extended ExtensionAPI action methods
